newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Q3 production capacity usage rises slightly.
newsitem.headline: Spain Q3 production capacity usage rises slightly.

text.p: Spain's production capacity usage index rose to 77.6 in the third quarter from 77.1 in the second quarter, the Industry Ministry said on Friday.
The improvement was due to more dynamic demand reflected in lower stock levels and an increase in total orders pending, the Ministry's industrial survey found.
The production capacity usage index was 76.1 in the first quarter.
